zh-tw.title: 程式語言
zh-tw.heading: 步驟 04／語言模組
zh-tw.scope: 建立或導入時選擇語言；Issue PR 只跑所選模組，交付 PR 再完成建置與打包。所有入口都讀取同一份公版設定。

en.title: Programming languages
en.heading: Step 04 / Language modules
en.scope: Languages are selected during creation or adoption. Issue PRs run the selected modules, while release PRs add builds and packaging. Every entrypoint reads the same template configuration.

zh-tw.title: 設定與實際檔案一致
zh-tw.description: 公版設定列出的語言必須和 repo 內的 Python、Rust、TypeScript 專案檔一致。

en.title: Configuration matches repository files
en.description: Languages listed by the template configuration must match the Python, Rust, and TypeScript project files in the repository.

trigger.zh-tw: 修改程式、套件或公版設定的 Issue PR
trigger.en: Issue PR changing code, dependencies, or template settings

note.zh-tw: 確認 Copier 建立單一設定檔，並正確組合各語言模組。
note.en: Confirms that Copier creates one configuration file and composes the selected language modules correctly.

zh-tw.title: 各語言使用自己的檢查
zh-tw.description: Python、Rust、TypeScript 各自執行格式、靜態檢查、測試與必要的建置；共通規則只跑一次。

en.title: Each language runs its native checks
en.description: Python, Rust, and TypeScript each run their own formatting, static checks, tests, and required builds while shared rules run once.

note.zh-tw: 另外建立各語言與多選範例，確認生成、更新與鎖檔仍可使用。
note.en: Additionally creates single- and multi-language fixtures to confirm generation, updates, and lockfiles remain usable.
